questions.question: What covenant does Psalm 89 celebrate and then lament?
options: God's creation of the heavens and earth
God's deliverance of Israel from Egypt
God's law given on Mount Sinai
God's covenant with David and his throne
questions.answer: God's covenant with David and his throne

questions.question: How does the psalm begin?
options: 'The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want'
'Out of the depths I cry to you, O LORD'
'How long, O LORD? Will you hide yourself away forever?'
'I will sing of the steadfast love of the LORD forever'
questions.answer: 'I will sing of the steadfast love of the LORD forever'

questions.question: God swore that David's offspring would endure forever and his throne as the days of the heavens.
